pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Annunciation — Gabriel greeting Mary with the lily standing between them, You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor
pictures.name: pd_eyck_tijd

pictures.scene: Gustav Bauernfeind, The Western Wall — the people gathered close to pray at the great stones, the appointed time has come, for Your servants delight in her stones
pictures.name: pd_bauernfeind_stenen

pictures.scene: Paolo Veronese, The Adoration of the Magi — kings kneeling with their gifts before the Virgin and Child, and take pity on her dust, so the nations will fear the name of the LORD
pictures.name: pd_veronese_volken

pictures.scene: Rembrandt van Rijn, The Ascension — Christ rising in a burst of light above the disciples, and all the kings of the earth will fear Your glory, for the LORD will rebuild Zion
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_heerlijkheid

pictures.scene: Mikhail Nesterov, Study for Holy Russia — a poor old pilgrim woman leaning on her staff in the snow, He has appeared in His glory, He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute
pictures.name: pd_nesterov_behoeftigen

pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, Saint John the Evangelist on Patmos — the young saint with his quill over the open book and the vision in the sky, He will not despise their prayer, let this be written for the generation to come, so that a people not yet created may praise the LORD
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_geschreven

lines.text: You will rise up and have compassion on Zion,
for it is time to show her favor—
For Your servants delight in her stones
and take pity on her dust.
So the nations will fear the name of the LORD,
and all the kings of the earth will fear Your glory.
For the LORD will rebuild Zion;
He has appeared in His glory.
He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute;
He will not despise their prayer.
Let this be written for the generation to come,
so that a people not yet created may praise the LORD.
